goal: FPGA faster than each baseline; software ordering unrestricted

config.bandwidth_definition: One native AXI R or W beat per bank per period; narrow beats consume a full slot
limitations: No DRAM row locality, refresh or physical HBM placement
Fair held grants can introduce head-of-line blocking

native_d3_w8.graph_scope: complete native RRG; no edge editing or sample selection

native_d4_w8.graph_scope: complete native RRG; no edge editing or sample selection

worker.cold_definition: First compute in a fresh process; graph allocation/upload precedes E1 and is separately reported.
worker.warm_definition: Five subsequent complete batches using the same allocations; all state/output reset every invocation.
